paragraphs.text: Dean Moseo is an owlin skeleton warlock teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

As an osteomancer, Moseo wields formidable control over bone, shaping magic from marrow and even manipulating opponents by animating the skeletons within their living bodies. Though his skeletal form unsettles some, Moseo personally prefers it to his former flesh and delights in using it to startle his students. Despite this, his dry humor and his skeletal pest companion, Rinata , tend to win over even the most uneasy pupils.

Moseo, formerly a professor of osteomancy, came perilously close to being compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion . Acting with remarkable speed, he cast a dangerous spell that purged the Phyrexian corruption from his body before it could fully claim him. The spell succeeded — but at a cost: leaving him as only an animated skeleton. In the wake of the Invasion, Witherbloom suffered heavy losses, particularly among its professors who had served as frontline healers. Stepping into this void, Moseo chose to assume the role of Dean of the Vein following Valentin 's death.
